purpose: Implement and check a single fixed post-visual-Linear scale operator on fresh matched initial models; no training comparison.
claims_and_guards: Only two visual projection outputs are scaled; original tanh, input normalization, masked raw skip, labels, tasks, actions and loss remain unchanged.
No learned affine, batch/running statistics, new trainable parameters, centering or validation-tuned scale constant.
Per-vector mathematical RMS r/sqrt(1+r*r) is at most 1 up to float32 rounding; individual coordinates may still saturate tanh.
The operator compresses amplitude information and may attenuate gradients; no nonzero float32 gradient lower bound is promised.
Same-seed variants must have byte-identical named parameters and disjoint parameter storage; preserve the current old reference.
Input-normalized reference must exactly replay the old train-step1 smoke input/target/draw/prediction/activation/gradient checks.
Controlled variant uses a new schema and persistent int64 version marker; old native or normalization-only checkpoints must fail strict loading.
No existing learned checkpoint is loaded or modified; synthetic in-memory state roundtrip is not a trained checkpoint deliverable.
Full-pack hashes and prior read-only provenance audit may inspect validation bytes; this smoke performs zero validation predictions or model selection.
Report only interface, numerical, masking, candidate-causality and zero-update evidence. Training gains require a separately authorized matched-budget experiment.
No policy rollout, PI0.5 backbone operation, project data inspection, oracle fields, tactile/rotation, formal-readiness or real-system claim.
